clues: This city sits by a river in the north west of its land, right next to the chief town. Folk call the two of them the twin towns.
Thunder storms boom over this town more than ninety times in a year. No other flat land town in the whole land is struck so often.
A chief of the Gakhar folk first set up this town in the year 1493. It stayed just a small town for a long stretch of time.
The top head office of the whole army of this land sits in this town. The chiefs of the army have run their work from here for years.
For a stretch of years, this town did the work of a second capital for the land. Then a brand new capital was built right next door to it.
